issues.failure_explanation: The chain bounds Delta_2 by p_bar_alpha(t,y-x) h^{gamma/alpha} times the integral I = int_h^t s^{-gamma/alpha}(t-s)^{-1/alpha} ds, and then asserts I < 1 (uniformly in t,h). With the substitution s = tu, I = t^{1-(gamma+1)/alpha} * integral_0^1 u^{-gamma/alpha}(1-u)^{-1/alpha} du, which is finite but of exact order t^{-(beta)/alpha} (since gamma = alpha+beta-1), so I diverges like t^{-beta/alpha} as t decreases to 0. Hence the claimed estimate |Delta_2| <~ p_bar_alpha(t,y-x) h^{gamma/alpha} is false as a uniform-in-t bound; the correct bound carries the extra factor t^{-beta/alpha}. This extra factor is harmless for the final statement of Theorem thm-main, whose right-hand side already contains the factor (1+t^{-beta/alpha}), but the displayed intermediate conclusion is not supported.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: In (maj-D2-mainthm), keep the factor t^{-beta/alpha}, i.e. conclude |Delta_2| <~ p_bar_alpha(t,y-x) h^{gamma/alpha} t^{-beta/alpha}; this is dominated by the bound (BD_THM) already claimed in the theorem, so no other step of the proof changes.
issues.overall_effect: Only the intermediate estimate (maj-D2-mainthm) is invalidated; the final convergence rate of Theorem thm-main survives, since h^{gamma/alpha} t^{-beta/alpha} is dominated by the advertised (1+t^{-beta/alpha}) h^{gamma/alpha}.
issues.title: Unsupported uniform-in-time bound of the Volterra integral in the Delta_2 estimate
issues.why_classification: A routine local correction (retaining the factor t^{-beta/alpha} in one intermediate display) suffices; the corrected estimate is still dominated by the theorem's stated bound, so every substantive claim, rate and guarantee of Theorem thm-main is preserved.
